0:8001.name: Warrior
publicDialogue: Those without power fall prey to those with power.

0:8005.name: Knight
publicDialogue: The strong have a duty to protect the weak.

0:2970.name: Drunk
publicDialogue: Experts come here to hunt and discuss ideas.
I come for the cheap ale.

0:8008.name: Bartender
publicDialogue: A hot meal before the road? I buy herbs and kitchen ingredients, too.

0:884130.name: Solgata · S-rank captain
publicDialogue: Solgata watches over the guild beneath the oak crest.

2:531288.name: Tome
publicDialogue: Do you prefer the sky or the sea?

2:569106.name: Gargoyle
publicDialogue: They say a crazy old hermit lives in the forest to the east.

2:554865.name: Undine
publicDialogue: My husband left the city a year ago and never returned.

2:41.name: Dullahan
publicDialogue: Survive my minions, and you shall earn glory. Prepare yourself!

2:527768.name: Companion broker
publicDialogue: A friend in need is a friend indeed.

2:42.name: Monster keeper
publicDialogue: Don't go out of the castle alone.

2:557424.name: Armorer
publicDialogue: Don't leave the castle unless you can defend yourself.

2:573586.name: Card dealer
publicDialogue: Do not underestimate your own ignorance.

2:595899.name: Provisioner
publicDialogue: A life saving trinket can be considered another life!

2:571258.name: Skeleton
publicDialogue: There is no good or evil, only friend or foe.

2:582838.name: Goblin
publicDialogue: I should never have come to this town.

2:593938.name: Sylph
publicDialogue: Monster attacks have become more frequent.

2:313.name: Empress
publicDialogue: I am the Empress! Give me all your shiny rocks! Kee hee!

2:312.name: High Priestess
publicDialogue: The future says... you look tasty! Wait, I mean, bright!

2:315.name: Heirophant
publicDialogue: Repent your sins! Especially if you don't like Imps!

2:202.name: Fool
publicDialogue: When you face off against the Dark Emperor, I'll be standing right there with you!

2:8401.name: Noble
publicDialogue: A recommendation carries my name. Show me what you do when someone needs help before you ask what it will earn you.

2:8402.name: Priest
publicDialogue: An acolyte learns to notice suffering, then to offer useful care. Let us begin with one person.

2:8403.name: Mage
publicDialogue: Observe first. Describe precisely. A patron cannot recommend an apprentice who mistakes a guess for a discovery.

2:8404.name: Rogue
publicDialogue: No grand speeches. Recover a misplaced ledger without hurting anyone, and perhaps we can discuss an apprenticeship.

2:8405.name: Cherry
publicDialogue: I do not teach strangers. You know my teacher? Prove it. People will say anything to get into my good graces. Bring me a signed recommendation from Dancer at the Travelers’ Guild, and then we can talk about lessons.

2:8406.name: Injured courier
publicDialogue: The road can wait. My leg cannot. Did the priest send you?

2:888240.name: Fisher
publicDialogue: When the tide goes out, we haul the boats onto the shingle. See the jars by the slip? Those came in on the morning tide.

2:888311.name: Child
publicDialogue: Three bowls. She always gives me the chipped one. I like it because it looks like a tooth.

2:888312.name: Goblin child
publicDialogue: She let me keep my blanket. The other guild wanted a coin for it.

2:888313.name: Pixie child
publicDialogue: Mine’s the high bed. Rogue had to measure twice to leave room for my wings.

2:890001.name: Gaoler
publicDialogue: The cells are down the side stair. Keep clear of the lower dungeon.

2:891003.name: Baker
publicDialogue: The children’s bread is set aside.

2:891004.name: Lookout
publicDialogue: We take turns at the door now. Nobody here has to keep watch alone.

4:887000.name: Sailor
publicDialogue: The ship carries travellers to Tintagel. Ask at the gangway when you are ready.
Rest here before crossing the dunes. The red pyramid stands in the southeast.

4:887001.name: Merchant
publicDialogue: Water, supplies, and cards for the desert road.

4:887002.name: Innkeeper
publicDialogue: Come in out of the heat. We keep the lamps burning for returning travellers.

5:1.name: Gargoyle
publicDialogue: Hand over a card, or I'll crush your bones!!

5:8006.name: Hunter
publicDialogue: Nature teaches those who listen. This cabin is my home now. If you have come to learn survival, you are welcome.

6:893050.name: Baker
publicDialogue: It took two days to get the oven dry. That first loaf hardly rose. We ate it warm anyway.

6:893051.name: Sailor
publicDialogue: West through the narrows for Avalon. We brought flour back in the same hold that went out empty.

9:9.name: Ice Queen
publicDialogue: Without this ally, the Dark Emperor has lost control of the sea...
But the heavens belong to him...
The domain of the Fairy Queen lies ahead.
The King of Swords lays siege to her realm.

9:893020.name: Pirate
publicDialogue: Sleep while the sun’s up? On this island that would be a waste of a good bed.

9:893021.name: Lookout
publicDialogue: A white gull on a split mast. If you see that flag out there, give her room.

9:893022.name: Deckhand
publicDialogue: We picked these barrels out of the wrecks. The grain was already spoiled.

14:10.name: Gnome
publicDialogue: They say an immortal has entered seculsion somewhere in this forest.

14:11.name: Gnome
publicDialogue: I heard yelling... I think someone tried to rob the fortress.

14:12.name: Gnome
publicDialogue: Feel free to use my forge anytime.

15:2.name: Treasure Snake
publicDialogue: You plan to challenge the Dark Emperor?... Take thisssss....

17:0.name: Resident
publicDialogue: He said that true freedom meant burning down the old world.
Instead, I burned my soul for his amusement.
Look at you, marching upward to your destiny...

19:0.name: Resident
publicDialogue: He told me that a King of Swords should kneel to no Queen... that the sky belonged to me.
Thus I rained fire upon the land, burning the innocent, to fuel my vanity.
Only to die a tyrant, for what? A hoard of meaningless gold?

20:0.name: Resident
publicDialogue: I built walls of stone to keep her safe...
He warned me the Queens would tear those walls down. That the only defense was a brutal offense.
I fought for love. I fought for my family. I was a pawn. I lost everything...

21:0.name: Fool
publicDialogue: Um, so actually...There is no Dark Emperor.
I offered each of the Kings what they most desired.

31:3.name: Neophyte
publicDialogue: We can finally begin rebuilding the castle.

31:4.name: Neophyte
publicDialogue: Thank the stars you arrived when you did.
I thought we were done for.

33:891036.name: Lady of the keep
publicDialogue: Lancelot’s father held this hall. If you can keep a roof over a few more beds, there will be someone here to tell you about him.

33:891037.name: Recruit
publicDialogue: Yesterday he showed us where a shield strap pinches. Today I can lift it without losing the feeling in my fingers.

33:891038.name: Recruit
publicDialogue: If I stand here, I can see the road all the way to the quay.

34:892019.name: Observatory apprentice
publicDialogue: We leave a copy of each chart here. Boat crews keep taking them back to Ger to plot their crossings.

0:8007.name: The Moors card sage
publicDialogue: The road writes on you. Let us see what the cards can read.

2:2970.name: Drunk
publicDialogue: Experts come here to hunt and discuss ideas.
I come for the cheap ale.

2:888203.name: Haven
publicDialogue: Follow the quay west for the island well. The lane past the fishers’ houses leads inland to the court and market.

2:888216.name: Market crossroads
publicDialogue: Castle and noble quarter: north. River settlement: northeast. Tintagel Village: southeast. Tavern and slums: southwest.

2:888217.name: River settlement
publicDialogue: River settlement · The trading house stands above the crossing. The eastern path continues to Savage Forest.

2:888218.name: Tintagel Village
publicDialogue: Tintagel Village, Logres. The inn faces the square. The stable yard is just east of here.

2:888219.name: Noble quarter
publicDialogue: Noble quarter · The Emperor holds court in the stone hall to the west.

2:888220.name: Slums
publicDialogue: Slums · Follow the narrow lane between the houses.

45:969001.name: Valley road warden
publicDialogue: The old estates have begun sending invitations again. Ask me about the black-wax seal.

45:969003.name: Pale estate steward
publicDialogue: My patron values fine jewels and accomplished performers. An invitation is a mark of favour.

45:970006.name: Roadside vampire hunter
publicDialogue: I watch the estates, not every traveller who keeps late hours. A name and a written agreement are worth more than a rumour.

117:970003.name: Host of the Silver Thorn
publicDialogue: A house is judged by its hospitality. I collect records, and I expect agreements to be honoured.

117:970004.name: Missing copyist
publicDialogue: I finished the agreed copy. The steward has kept my travel papers.
My Queen commands me to defend you!
I shall lend you my blade!
Ooh, shiny weapons! Give them here!
Hss! Fresh meat in our waters!
The storm brings us a feast!
His ship never returned... neither will yours.
Do you hear the sails? No... only the waves.
Why do you get to go home when he couldn't?
The peak belongs to the cold.
This forest is ours! We claim it!
This forest is ours! We claim it!
This forest is ours! We claim it!

This forest is ours! We claim it!
We lost our home! Now you want to kill us?

46:8003.name: Mage
publicDialogue: Athens and Ger have much to teach one another.

46:974001.name: Athenian scholar
publicDialogue: A source, a place and an hour. Begin there before you make a claim.

46:974006.name: Athenian guild clerk
publicDialogue: Mage handles lessons at the main desk. Students in Ger and Athens share their rank and records.

49:900051.name: North · Hatti and the Aegean ferry

49:900052.name: South · Qedar. Keep to the marked pass.

publicDialogue: The King of Wands claims this desert!
Burn the Queen's sanctuary to ash! Kee hee!
The Witch Queen's reign ends today!
Ashes to ashes, flesh to cinders!

4:890097.name: Tingis · Port of Ger
publicDialogue: Ger. Ships for Logres sail from this quay. The market and inn lie inland.

4:896130.name: East · Kemet via the caravan road

119:972319.name: Falias archivist
publicDialogue: A stone court beneath the northern mountains.

120:972320.name: Gorias archivist
publicDialogue: A northern school among pines and high lakes.

118:972318.name: Murias archivist
publicDialogue: A sheltered harbour of scholars and shipwrights.

publicDialogue: A lakeside school above the eastern shore.
